A real library, an illustrative setting.

The home page photograph shows the George Peabody Library in Baltimore, Maryland. It is an inspirational library image and does not depict a Morrowfield campus or imply an affiliation.

Photo: George-peabody-library.jpg by Matthew Petroff, used under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported.

The source photograph was resized and converted to WebP for local delivery. Its display is cropped responsively; the supplied image derivatives remain under CC BY-SA 3.0. No school ownership or endorsement is implied.

An identity made for this site.

The Morrowfield name, book-and-shield mark, academic illustration, pathway names and editorial learning guides were created for this demonstration. The site does not copy the identity, claims or contact details of an existing school.

The open-book and orbital illustration is original vector artwork, served directly in the home page. The mark is an original local SVG.

Credit where it belongs.

Linked organizations retain their own names, content and rights. Inclusion in the resource library does not imply partnership or endorsement. Review each provider’s terms and rights notices before reusing material.

The software license and authorship notices are preserved in the Terms of Service.

Information pages & your launch choice.

Our approach, Terms of Service, Privacy, Accessibility and Credits follow the saved Search launch preferences in Settings. They open in the same tab by default. The Search new-tab choice opens a normal new tab; Search about:blank opens these local information pages inside a separate about:blank tab. Learning guides and external resource links keep ordinary browser navigation.

If your browser blocks a new tab, the selected page opens in the current tab. In an about:blank tab, Back returns through information pages or to Academy home, and Open normally opens the current document directly. Academy home, external links and Continue to Heavenly open their destination in that tab.
